title: Recurrent neural networks – 1980 (Memory)
extracted_text:
RECURRENT NEURAL NETWORKS

RNNs were designed to work with sequential data by maintaining a hidden state that captures information about previous inputs.

They were a significant advancement for generative models, allowing for the generation of sequences of text, music, and more.
